name: Apache Airflow
summary: Start runs of approved Ogun workflow versions from Airflow DAGs, wait or defer, and sense runs and partitions. Airflow calls Ogun with an agent credential and cannot approve.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.label: Credential name
fields.help: Created once on a terminal: ogun credentials add NAME --kind agent. Default airflow. The token stays in Ogun's state directory.

settings.name: conn_id
settings.label: Airflow connection id
settings.help: A connection of type ogun. Its extras only name the credential; they hold no secret.

settings.name: ogun_home
settings.label: Ogun state directory
settings.help: As $OGUN_HOME. The platform default for the worker's user when empty.

settings.name: agent_file
settings.label: Credential file
settings.help: Explicit path of the credential file instead of a name.

settings.name: timeout_s
settings.label: Call timeout (seconds)
settings.help: Socket timeout of one call to ogund.

egress.note: The provider reaches ogund through its local socket on the same machine (O-15 section 2); nothing leaves the host. The server bridge (ADR 0010) is for remote workers and these packages do not use it yet.

implementation.evidence: Built, not yet run against the real counterpart: IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS says Airflow was checked only against stub modules.

notes: Package airflow-provider-ogun: OgunHook (connection type ogun), OgunRunOperator, OgunRunSensor, OgunPartitionSensor, OgunRunTrigger. Pin workflow_hash to the version a person approved. A run that needs an approval waits for a person on the Ogun CLI or in Studio.
